The Must PV18-3024 ECO 3000VA Solar Inverter is a high efficiency pure sine wave inverter designed for home and office solar power systems. With a strong 3000VA 2400W output capacity, this inverter delivers stable and reliable power for your appliances while ensuring smooth operation with solar, battery and grid input.


This model is ideal for users who want a cost effective hybrid inverter with intelligent energy management. It supports solar charging, AC charging and battery charging, making it perfect for areas with frequent power outages. D CORE offers the Must PV18-3024 ECO as a dependable solution for building a modern and efficient solar backup system.


Key Features


  • 3000VA 2400W pure sine wave output for stable and safe operation
  • Built in MPPT solar charge controller for efficient solar energy use
  • Supports solar, battery and grid input for flexible energy management
  • LCD display for quick monitoring of system status
  • Wide input voltage range suitable for unstable grid conditions
  • Overload, short circuit and over temperature protection
  • High efficiency design reduces power loss and improves performance
  • Intelligent battery charging with multiple protection layers
  • Suitable for home, office and small commercial setups
  • Ideal hybrid solution for power backup and renewable energy use
